parole.testo: Usually derived from Proto-Indo-European *h₂lek- (“to protect”), but it could instead be from a non-Indo-European substrate language. Comparable to Lithuanian alkas, Gothic 𐌰𐌻𐌷𐍃 (alhs, “temple”).

parole.significato: silver (precious metal; chemical element, with atomic number 47.)
parole.testo: From a late Proto-Indo-European root common to Balto-Slavic and Germanic for “silver”, not attested in other branches of Indo-European, likely borrowed from a non-Indo-European substrate.
